title: Metal colours fixed: neutral silver base layer, Terraria-tuned tints, real ingots
player_outcome: Ore tiers are colour-coded and bright like Terraria: copper orange, tin khaki, iron grey, silver white, gold yellow, demonite purple, crimtane red, hellstone glowing orange-red, cobalt blue, mythril teal, orichalcum pink, adamantite red, titanium silver-blue. Bars look like chunky ingots.
design: Verified: build_all.py:29 METAL_LAYERS = {copper, gold}; every other metal multiplies its tint onto the grey iron layer (#8a8e96), so copper, palladium and hellstone all come out brown. The bar is two 12-tri trapezoids.

tools/textures/props.json: append a 'silver' metal layer (base #d8dadf, dark #a8acb4, light #f4f6fa, roughness 0.3) and rebuild with tools/textures/build_textures.py --set=props. Appending keeps existing indices in layers.json.
build_all.plan: the default metalLayer is 'silver' for all metals except copper and gold (keep their layers or also switch; decide by icon medians).

Retune assets.json 'metals' hexes against Terraria. Add accents: hellstone and meteorite get prop:plain:glow crack veins (detail.veins); demonite and crimtane a darker edge colour; hallowed gold-white.
items.bar becomes a bevelled ingot (extrude with chamfer, lighter top face, 2 stacked, ~150 tris).
export.apply_textured_materials: icon materials get metallic from the layer type so icons match in-game.
Rebuild all {metal}_* patterns, bars and armour icons: build_all.py --only='*_pickaxe,*_axe,*_hammer,*_broadsword,*_shortsword,*_bow,*_helmet,*_chainmail,*_greaves,*_bar,*_drill,*_chainsaw'.
files_modify: tools/textures/gen_built.py — metal layer params if needed
data_changes: assets.json metals: copper #e8804a, tin #d0c8a0, iron #a8acb4, lead #5a6680, silver #eef0f4, tungsten #8ac080, gold #ffd040, platinum #d8ecf8, demonite #7a60d0, crimtane #d03848, hellstone #ff5a20 (glow), cobalt #2a8cff, palladium #ff8a5a, mythril #3ae0b0, orichalcum #ff60c8, adamantite #ff2a40, titanium #c8dcf0 (tune by eye)
